# Chart Reader by Asendify

> Chart Reader (https://charts.asendify.co) is an educational tool that explains screenshots of trading charts (stocks, crypto, forex, indices, commodities) in plain English. It is not financial advice: it never tells anyone to buy or sell. Made by Asendify.

## Key facts
- Each read covers: trend, market structure, key support and resistance zones read from the price axis, notable patterns, volume and indicator notes when visible, 2-3 conditional scenarios ("if price does X, traders often watch Y") with invalidation levels, position-size arithmetic from the user's own account size and risk % per trade (pure arithmetic), and what would change the picture.
- Every result carries this notice: educational analysis only, not financial advice, no guarantee of accuracy, trading carries a high risk of losing money.
- Price: 100 chart reads for £435 (£300 + 45% service fee of £135). One-time payment through PayPal. Reads never expire. Nothing is free (no free trial or free reads).
- Only successful reads use a credit: if the image is not a chart, or the reader fails, the read is given back automatically.
- Accounts: email plus one-time sign-in links (no passwords). Results are saved in the user's history.
- Screenshots are stored privately and deleted automatically after 30 days; written results are kept.
- How it works: an AI vision model reads the screenshot and writes the explanation to a fixed structure; it can misread blurry charts or cut-off price axes.
- Policies (payments and refunds): https://www.asendify.co/policies/

## Every feature, by name
- Upload any chart screenshot: PNG, JPG or WebP; tap to choose or drop the image in
- Automatic resizing: images are resized in your browser before upload (up to 1600 px, under 2 MB)
- Any platform: screenshots from TradingView, MetaTrader, broker apps or exchanges
- Any market: stocks, crypto, forex, indices and commodities
- Chart types: candlestick, bar, line and Heikin Ashi charts
- Instrument and timeframe: read from the chart when they are visible
- Trend direction: up, down, sideways or unclear, with a 2–3 sentence explanation
- Market structure: higher highs and lows, ranges and breakouts in plain English
- Support and resistance zones: read from the price axis, each with a label and why it matters
- Chart pattern notes: up to six notable patterns, with where they are and how clear they are
- Volume and indicator notes: only when volume or indicators are visible on your screenshot
- 2–3 conditional scenarios: "If price does X, traders often watch Y"
- Trigger and invalidation levels: each scenario has a level and the price that would cancel it
- What would change the picture: the signs that would make the read out of date
- Quality note: says when a blurry chart or cut-off axis limits the read
- Never invents prices: if the price axis can't be read, levels are left blank instead of guessed
- Position-size arithmetic: risk amount = account size × risk % per trade
- Size for each scenario: units = risk amount ÷ distance from level to invalidation, with distance %, position value and leverage
- 11 account currencies: GBP, USD, EUR, INR, AUD, CAD, AED, SGD, JPY, CHF and USDT
- Optional notes: add the timeframe, the market and what you want to learn from the chart
- No buy or sell calls: an automatic check rejects any read that tells you to buy or sell
- Not-a-chart check: photos, memes or documents are turned away and the read is given back
- Only successful reads count: if a read fails, it is given back automatically
- Saved history: every read is saved to your account to reopen and compare later
- Private screenshots: stored privately and deleted after 30 days; the written read stays
- Passwordless sign-in: a one-time sign-in link by email
- 100 reads that never expire: one pack, no subscription
- No app to install: works in any modern browser on phone or computer

## Who Chart Reader is for
- Beginner and improving traders who want to understand what a chart is showing, in plain English.
- People learning technical analysis who want a consistent structure (trend, levels, patterns, scenarios) to check their own read against.
- Traders who want the position-size maths for their own risk rule worked out for each scenario.

## Who it's not for
- Anyone looking for buy or sell signals or trade calls: Chart Reader never gives them.
- Traders who need live data, alerts or automated trading: it reads one screenshot at a time.
- Anyone who wants guaranteed accuracy: it is an AI read that can be wrong, so check the levels yourself.
